regime_context: The detector shows a narrow leadership cluster in Hong Kong: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible, with Energy (H-shares) ranked first on high durability (0.76, trend-tagged) and High-Dividend Blue Chips second. Momentum rank is a focus lens only, not alpha; the absolute-trend gate is the sole validated risk-control leg. Macro narrative is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics, with unscheduled share at 1.0 — coincident market-level context only. Honest note: nearly every theme is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so conviction must be low and calls hard to grade.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) loses its trend-gate eligibility on the next check — leader margin over High-Dividend is 0.293, and rotation breadth of 0.24 signals a very narrow regime. A confirmed drop in Energy durability bar below ~0.6 with High-Dividend holding its trend tag would mark a leadership handoff to the dividend complex.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Second-ranked trend-eligible theme with durability 0.70, trend-tagged, and breadth 0.625 (majority of constituents participating). Better risk profile than Energy via the trend gate, and unlike Energy it is not the crowded leader. The trend-gate eligibility is the only leg with validated drawdown-control value, and dividend blue chips being eligible supports staying-power over a mean-reversion-prone market. But this is a focus lens, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: High-dividend themes often trade as defensives; if broad risk appetite returns, this may lag higher-beta recovery names, and momentum rank itself has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips lags the Hang Seng by 5% or more before the check-by date, or falls below trend-gate eligibility

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Third-ranked and trend-eligible, but hurst_tag is mean-revert rather than trend — this weakens the trend-gate case. Breadth 0.538 and durability 0.56 are mediocre but positive. Crowding_z 0.86 is elevated but not flagged crowded; treat as a size-down caution only. The call rests on the absolute-trend gate showing eligibility, not on momentum.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag suggests this leadership is less persistent; rising rates or property-related NPL concerns in HK financials could reverse quickly.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) falls out of trend eligibility (score declines) or lags the Hang Seng by 8% before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
